description: Run a read-only Wear OS Data Layer preflight across a connected phone and watch. Checks device roles, Google Play services, Bluetooth, optional app packages, companion association presence, and Data Layer service signals without exposing pairing identifiers.

phoneDevice.description: Phone device serial; auto-detected when omitted

phonePackage.description: Optional companion app package expected on the phone

wearDevice.description: Wear device serial; auto-detected when omitted

wearPackage.description: Optional Wear app package expected on the watch

name: adb_wear_datalayer_preflight
